The '''Mothma estate''' was the residence of the [[Mothma family/Legends|Mothma family]] in the prairies of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Nanda (ensign)|Nanda]] there to investigate the childhood home of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kell Bircher]], a traitor to the Empire. When Nanda discovered tombstones bearing the name of Mothma, Vader realized that Bircher was related to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], leader of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] against the Empire, and he ordered the destruction of the Mothma estate as an act of revenge.<ref name="SW14" />
